[[File:Surveillance_cam.jpg|thumb|View through a surveillance cam]]
A '''surveillance camera''', '''surveil-cam''',<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref> '''surveillance imager'''<ref name="SF">{{JournalCite|12|Small Favors}}</ref> or '''cam''' was a security device that could be used to spy on people, or to look after a place. They could be disguised into a number of ingenious locations. [[Chay Praysh]] used them throughout his [[Praysh's Fortress|fort]] to keep things in order. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was able to pass undetected in the fort as she flung mud into the lense of the camera.

During the [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|battle]] of [[Altyr V]], [[Kyle Katarn]] infiltrated an [[Empire Reborn|Imperial]] base disguised as an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], from which the Empire dispatched its invasion force. At some point, Katarn gained access to a surveillance camera control post, utilizing the surveilance cams installed around the base to get his bearings.

Surveillance cams could also be independently mobile, allowing them to follow a suspected criminal for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]].<ref name="Ringers" />
